positions.title: Founding Member, Head of Options Research
positions.description:
- Co-Founded Davinci Market Systems, a financial service LLC dedicated to providing real time market data and resources for retail traders
- Used the Discord API and Pandas to create real time alerts via webhook for unusual market activity and notable block/sweep orders on U.S equity options.
- Published daily reports on activity and notable signals on U.S options and ETFs
- Created a curriculum for trading theta and volatility at a retail level, including weekly lectures and private sessions with community members
- Worked with over 400 active clients and 2,800 active users for customized options reports, flow, and real-time market data

positions.description:
• Campaigned through phone-banking, canvassing, out reach and other means
 • Coordinated Public Relations projects with local ethnic groups within the 8th district

As an AAPI, to work to get one of our own in office is not only important to me, but to the AAPI minority in the United States as a whole. volunteerExperiences.description:
2020 - CIMUN XVI Simulations Staff (Political Officer, General Assembly 1989)
2021 - CIMUN XVII Simulations Staff (Station Officer), MIMUN VIII Simulations Staff
2022 - MIMUN IX Simulations Staff
2023 - MIMUN X Simulations Staff

In 2018, Foxconn's new plant in Wisconsin threatened Illinois' wetlands along the Des Plaines River watershed. In response, I dedicated my Eagle Project to planting over 18 million seeds in Lake County Forest Preserve to restore wetlands necessary to protecting the local ecosystem in and around Lake County. With over 25 participating volunteers, and the support my Boy Scout Troop 100, we were able to successfully harvest a diverse range of native wetland species and plant them before the approaching winter months.

In 2018, Foxconn's new plant in Wisconsin threatened Illinois' wetlands along the Des Plaines River watershed. In response, I dedicated my Eagle Project to planting over 18 million seeds in Lake County Forest Preserve to restore wetlands necessary to protecting the local ecosystem in and around Lake County. With over 25 participating volunteers, and the support my Boy Scout Troop 100, we were able to successfully harvest a diverse range of native wetland species and plant them before the approaching winter months.
